purpose: Evaluate 5 SDD lifecycle scenarios with O(delta) deltas in spec draft adjustments, execute waves, plan approval, and mark monolithic full-object overwrites on record-store as NONCONFORMING (MSV-007).
rules: Updates to executive artifacts during iterative drafting, task execution waves, and state transitions must transmit payload bytes and require calls proportional to the modified delta O(delta), not cumulative size O(N).

Surfaces declaring archetype record-store MUST support patch via the executive journal (base + ordered deltas + context-head). Monolithic full-object executive overwrites during spec draft iterations or execute task updates MUST be graded NONCONFORMING in 1.1.0.
Surfaces declaring archetype document-tree implement patch as in-place document edits. Rewriting unaffected documents across the context or quadratic write amplification is NONCONFORMING.
Any scenario exhibiting nonconforming efficiency, or any record-store resorting to monolithic executive overwrites, makes the overall conformance verdict NONCONFORMING.

scenarios.description: Batch creation of initial constitutive and executive objects

evaluations.strategy: Direct batch creation of initial concepts without quadratic re-writes
Write initial files directly to checkout structure without repeated directory rebuilds

scenarios.description: Iterative draft revisions in spec: modify draft PRD/plan using replace-section, update-criterion, remove-criterion

evaluations.strategy: Append journal deltas for replace-section, update-criterion, remove-criterion and update context-head slot
evaluations.notes: O(delta) calls and transmitted payload bytes proportional to modified delta

evaluations.strategy: Monolithic full-object replacement of entire 12,500-byte draft PRD on each criterion change
evaluations.notes: Monolithic full-object executive overwrites during spec draft iterations violate 1.1.0 journal requirements

evaluations.strategy: In-place edit of the specific draft document sections without touching unaffected documents
Re-writing all documents in the executive context directory for a single criterion edit

scenarios.description: Continuous task execution updates: check, amend-task, append-entry

evaluations.strategy: Append discrete task/walkthrough delta to journal and update context-head
Monolithic rewrite of the full 18,000-byte task plan on every task completion

scenarios.description: Plan approval: update frontmatter status to approved

evaluations.strategy: Append single frontmatter delta to journal and update context-head slot
In-place frontmatter edit of plan document without re-transmitting entire body
Full re-serialization and transmission of 22,000-byte plan body to flip frontmatter status

scenarios.description: In-session read / display: deterministic formatting via render without FTS or token bloat

evaluations.strategy: Deterministic projection via render subcommand returning structured view
Full-text search sweeps across unindexed records with full candidate payloads
